section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Limited Slip Differential
title: ASSEMBLY OF DIFFERENTIAL CASE

content.text: Wash the differential case and bolts with trichloroethylene.
NOTE: Other cleaning solvent may be used if it has the same degreasing effect as trichloroethylene.

content.description: Exploded view of differential case assembly showing adjusting washer and internal components including thrust washers, side gear, clutch members, and springs

content.text: 2. INSTALL FOLLOWING PARTS ON TO DIFFERENTIAL CASE
NOTE: Coat the parts with gear oil for LSD.

items: Clutch member RH with pinion gear

content.text: NOTE: Face the oil groove toward the clutch plate.
NOTE: Face the oil groove toward the clutch member.

content.description: Exploded view of differential case cover assembly showing adjusting washer and internal components

content.text: 3. INSTALL FOLLOWING PART ONTO DIFFERENTIAL CASE COVER
NOTE: Face the oil groove toward the clutch plate.
NOTE: Face the oil groove toward the clutch member.
Align the marks on the case and case cover.

content.description: Cross-section view showing alignment of marks on differential case and case cover, with arrows indicating points A and measurement 21
